title: The Blood Red Sea
summary: A treasure hunter was stabbed and his body was found on a beach. A rival treasure hunter is the main suspect but he has a solid alibi at Catherine's Bar at the time the murder occurred.
method: The idea was to frame the rival treasure hunter by supplying him rum so he would fall asleep and then committing the murder on his boat. Since the victim and his rival argued earlier in the day, the victim would eventually go back to the rival's boat to finish the argument. The killer stabbed the victim on the boat, planted the knife in the rival's hand, then went back to the restaurant. He took the victim's phone and made a call with it at the restaurant to establish an alibi. The rival unexpectedly woke up, threw the body overboard, and cleaned the boat before going to Catherine's bar. The plan to frame him didn't go according to plan because the alibi call happened after the victim was stabbed and they aren't able to discover the rival with the body of the victim.
motive: The killer was having an affair with the victim's wife and feared being disinherited.
killer: The victim's son and his stepmother
